description: This file defines Express.js routes for tenant-related API endpoints, including CRUD operations, navigation data retrieval, credit summaries, and user usage statistics. It interacts with MongoDB models and external services to gather and respond with tenant-specific data.

methods.name: router.get('/')
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all tenants.

methods.name: router.get('/:id')
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a tenant by ID.

methods.name: router.post('/')
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new tenant.

methods.name: router.put('/:id')
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update a tenant by ID.

methods.name: router.delete('/:id')
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a tenant by ID.

methods.name: router.get('/:tenantId/navigation')
methods.description: Retrieves navigation structure (groups, users, projects) for a specific tenant.

methods.name: router.get('/:tenantId/credits-summary')
methods.description: Provides a summary of tenant credits, including allocation, usage, and breakdowns.

methods.name: router.get('/:tenantId/users/usage')
methods.description: Returns per-user usage data, including total cost and minutes.
